gen-dafont-over-there-gf-hepta-slab: Over There commands with a fixed-width nib look and wide gaps between letters. Hepta Slab does the opposite job, stretching out bookish, dignified words with open counters that breathe.
gen-dafont-over-there-gf-kiwi-maru: Kiwi Maru sets traditional, editorial letters with generous spacing and round o shapes whose walls hold constant. Over There handles the commanding shouting; Kiwi Maru handles the patient talking.
gen-dafont-over-there-gf-padyakke-expand: Literary and authoritative, with c shapes gaping like a pitcher's mouth and glyphs strung far apart. Padyakke Expanded One keeps round bowls uniform throughout, so a page of it moves slowly beneath Over There's vintage-military command.
gen-dafont-over-there-gf-stint-ultra-exp: Authoritative and traditional, Stint Ultra Expanded floats each character apart. Beneath Over There's commanding nib strokes, its pipe-cleaner letterforms and open counters make paragraphs drift along slowly and spaciously.
gen-dafont-over-there-manrope: Over There looks drawn by a fixed-width nib, with generous white space between its commanding vintage-military letters. And Manrope's taller lowercase and bright curve openings add a clean, approachable ease against that stern look.
gen-dafont-over-there-satoshi: Stern and spaced out: Over There looks drawn with a fixed-width nib, vintage-military and commanding. Satoshi stands tall in sans form, its e never squeezed shut, giving the heading's wide gaps a straightforward partner.
gen-dafont-over-there-switzer: Over There brings vintage-military command, letters looking drawn by a fixed-width nib. But Switzer's wire-like sans letters and tall waist line keep paragraphs crisp and approachable, with c tips held well apart.
gen-dafont-over-there-work-sans: Over There hits with vintage-military authority, its nib-drawn letters spaced generously apart. And Work Sans, contemporary and modern, keeps its c tips apart and its mean line high, so text moves along smoothly.
gen-dafont-ozone-gf-esteban: Esteban is a refined serif with medium stroke contrast and a lowercase that looks oversized beside its capitals. And Ozone, geometric and technical, draws every stroke uniform with no thick-thin flicker, leaving Esteban's contrast to stand out.
gen-dafont-ozone-gf-faustina: Ozone draws wirelike strokes of a single thickness, geometric and technical, with capitals barely rising above the lowercase. But Faustina thins its bowls gently, so paragraphs move with a mild, classic, authoritative rhythm.
